title: Online Digital Archive
description: The aim of the DNB Online Digital Archive is to provide visual aids to stagers and teachers when selecting dance(s) that suit their preferences and needs in movement style, cast numbers, dancers' techniques, and/or choreography. There are a total of 66 dances represented by more than 100 video excerpts and notation in PDF. All of these are open for educational and research purposes. Please contact Mei-Chen Lu, Director of Library Services, library@dancenotation.org for educational and research use. Permission to stage the dances listed below vary in some cases. Please contact dnbinfo@dancenotation.org for the fees and staging information.
